plan_needed: A ChatGPT account. OpenAI's help centre couldn't be read on 15 Oct 2026, so which plans include the Google apps is unconfirmed. In ChatGPT Business or Enterprise the ChatGPT admin decides which apps are available. The Workspace admin's API controls must allow the app.

steps.do: Open Settings, then Apps
steps.see: The list of apps you can connect

steps.do: Click Connect next to the app
steps.see: A sign-in and permissions flow starts

steps.do: Complete the authentication and permissions flow
steps.see: The app is connected

steps.do: Choose the app under Tools
steps.see: ChatGPT can use the app in that chat

plan_needed: A ChatGPT account; plan requirements for the Gmail and Google Drive plugins are not stated in the pages we could read. Workspace-installed plugins are managed by the ChatGPT admin.

steps.where: ChatGPT on the web or the desktop app
steps.do: Open the Plugins tab
steps.see: The plugin directory (OpenAI, workspace and Personal tabs)

steps.do: Find the Gmail or Google Drive plugin, open it, and select the plus button to install it
steps.see: The plugin installs

steps.do: If prompted, connect and sign in
steps.see: The plugin can reach your Google account

steps.do: Describe the task, or type @ and pick the plugin
steps.see: ChatGPT uses the plugin for that task

plan_needed: ChatGPT Free, Go, Plus or Pro; OpenAI also lists Business, Enterprise, Edu and K-12 users. The Workspace admin must allow Marketplace installs or allowlist the add-on.

steps.where: Google Workspace Marketplace, 'ChatGPT' listing by OpenAI
steps.do: Install the add-on
steps.see: The add-on is added to your Google account

steps.do: Open a spreadsheet
steps.see: ChatGPT appears in a sidebar

steps.do: Sign in with your OpenAI account
steps.see: You can ask ChatGPT to build, edit or analyse the sheet

to: Google Workspace (Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive)
plan_needed: Any Claude plan, per Anthropic. On Team and Enterprise an Owner or Primary Owner must enable the connectors first. A Google admin may need to mark Claude as Trusted in API controls.

steps.do: Click + next to Connectors (or in a chat: click +, hover over Connectors, select Manage connectors, then click +)
steps.see: The connectors directory

steps.do: Click Gmail, Google Calendar or Google Drive, review the description, and click Connect
steps.see: A Google sign-in screen

steps.do: Complete the authentication prompts
steps.see: The connector shows as connected

steps.do: Click + (or type /), hover over Connectors, and toggle on the services you want
steps.see: Claude can use them in that conversation

plan_needed: Claude Team or Enterprise; Owner or Primary Owner role

steps.do: Click Browse connectors
steps.see: The connectors directory

steps.do: Select the Google connector and choose Add to your team
steps.see: Members can connect their own Google accounts; each person still signs in individually

plan_needed: Any Google Workspace edition; an admin who can manage API controls

steps.do: Go to Security > Access and data control > API controls > Manage third-party app access
steps.see: The list of configured apps

steps.do: Add the Claude app and set it to Trusted
steps.see: Claude is allowed to reach Workspace data

steps.do: Wait about 15 minutes
steps.see: Users can connect Claude's Google connectors

from: Claude for Google Workspace (Anthropic add-on, beta)
plan_needed: Claude Pro, Max, Team or Enterprise; a Google account that's allowed to install Marketplace apps

steps.where: Google Workspace Marketplace, 'Claude' listing by Anthropic
steps.do: Click Install
steps.see: One install covers Docs, Sheets and Slides

steps.where: A Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file
steps.do: Go to Extensions > Claude > Open Claude
steps.see: The Claude sidebar opens

steps.do: Allow the two permissions Google requests
steps.see: Claude can read and edit the open file

steps.do: Sign in with your Claude account (optionally turn on connectors)
steps.see: Claude is ready; reload any files that were already open

plan_needed: Google Workspace super admin; users need Claude Pro, Max, Team or Enterprise

steps.where: Claude listing in Google Workspace Marketplace, signed in as a super admin
steps.do: Click Admin install, then Continue
steps.see: Installation options

steps.do: Choose everyone in the organisation, or specific groups or organisational units
steps.see: Data access and terms to review

steps.do: Tick the agreement box and click Finish
steps.see: Claude is installed for the chosen users; they reload any open files

to: Gmail, Google Calendar or Google Contacts
plan_needed: A Microsoft 365 work account with Copilot Chat. Microsoft-published connectors are on unless the Microsoft 365 admin disables them. Whether a paid Microsoft 365 Copilot licence is needed was not confirmed.

steps.do: Select the ... menu, then Settings
steps.see: The settings dialog

steps.do: Select Sources in the left pane
steps.see: Available data sources

steps.do: Find Gmail (or Google Calendar or Google Contacts) and select Connect
steps.see: A Google sign-in

steps.do: Sign in with your own Google account and approve access
steps.see: The source is connected

steps.do: Ask your question, naming the source
steps.see: Copilot answers with live data fetched from Google

plan_needed: A Google Workspace admin to create a Google Cloud service account with domain-wide delegation and read-only scopes; a Microsoft 365 admin to deploy the connector

steps.where: Google Cloud and Google Admin console
steps.do: Create a service account with domain-wide delegation, add the four read-only scopes Microsoft lists, and create a JSON key
steps.see: A service account key ready to paste

steps.do: Select Copilot > Connectors
steps.see: The connectors page

steps.do: Select Google Drive
steps.see: The connector setup page

steps.do: Enter a display name, your Google Workspace domain and an administrator account email, then paste the service account key
steps.see: Connection details filled in

steps.do: Optionally choose Custom setup and set access to Only people with access to this data source, then choose Create
steps.see: Indexing starts straight away

to: Gmail, Google Drive, Google Calendar, Google Contacts
plan_needed: A personal Microsoft account on Copilot.com or the Copilot mobile app

steps.do: Select Profile, then Connectors
steps.see: A list of services you can connect

steps.do: Select Connect next to the service
steps.see: A prompt to continue

steps.do: Select Continue to… (for example, Continue to Gmail)
steps.see: Google's sign-in

steps.do: Choose the account and approve what Copilot can access
steps.see: You're returned to Copilot with the connector switched on

to: Asana, Atlassian Rovo, HubSpot, Mailchimp, Monday.com, QuickBooks, Salesforce
plan_needed: Business Standard or Plus, Enterprise Standard or Plus, or a supported add-on; the admin must allow integrations; some need a paid subscription to the other app

steps.where: Google Workspace Marketplace integrations page, on a computer
steps.do: Select the integration and click Connect
steps.see: Google's access prompts

steps.do: Follow the instructions to grant access, and install the helper app if the listing says one is needed
steps.see: The integration is connected

steps.where: Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive or Chat
steps.do: Click the Ask Gemini icon, type @ and select the integration
steps.see: The integration is attached to your prompt

steps.do: Enter your prompt and press Enter
steps.see: Gemini answers with information from the other app (read only)

plan_needed: A Workspace edition that includes Workspace Studio; admins may restrict integrations; paid third-party services need your own subscription

steps.do: Create a flow
steps.see: The flow editor

steps.do: Click the integration step; if it isn't connected, click Connect
steps.see: Instructions to let the integration access your Google Account data

steps.do: Follow the on-screen instructions, installing a helper app if asked
steps.see: The integration step is ready to configure

steps.do: Configure the step, optionally click Test run, then click Turn on
steps.see: The flow is live; note that a test run takes real actions

to: Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive, Google Docs, Google Keep, Google Tasks, Google Chat
plan_needed: A qualifying Workspace edition; the admin has the app enabled and conversation history on

steps.do: Sign in with the same account you use for Workspace
steps.see: The Gemini app

steps.do: Type @ and select the app
steps.see: The app is attached to your prompt

steps.do: Ask your question and click Submit
steps.see: Gemini answers using that app, if your admin has enabled it

from: An MCP client (for example Claude or Google Antigravity)
to: Gmail (Google's Gmail MCP server, Developer Preview)
plan_needed: Membership of the Google Workspace Developer Preview Program and a Google Cloud project; for Claude as the client, a Pro, Max, Team or Enterprise plan

steps.do: Enable the Gmail API and the Gmail MCP API
steps.see: Both APIs enabled

steps.where: Google Cloud console, OAuth consent screen
steps.do: Set the app name, audience, test users, and the gmail.readonly and gmail.compose scopes
steps.see: Consent screen configured

steps.do: Create an OAuth client ID and secret as a Web application, selecting Use this client for an AI-powered agent
steps.see: A client ID and secret

steps.do: Add the server https://gmailmcp.googleapis.com/mcp/v1 (Streamable HTTP) with the client ID and secret
steps.see: The client lists the Gmail tools

steps.do: Authenticate, then test with a prompt
steps.see: The AI can search and read threads, create drafts and apply labels
